question: Which Indian individual has taken the charge of Chairship of the International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (International IDEA) for the first time in December 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** • **India has been invited for the first time to chair the International Institute for Democracy and Electoral Assistance (International IDEA), and Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will assume the Chairship in Stockholm, Sweden.**
